events.title: Steam Playtest this Weekend

PLAYTEST DETAILSSign up and receive your key through our Discord - https://discord.gg/bgq3u9TgpjThis playtest session is running NOW until Monday 9AM CET (Sunday midnight PST)We would love to have as much feedback as possible and continue building this game with the community - we've received ´many valuable insights already and the game is looking better each day. We hope to see you out there, DRIFTERS!
